assert: R1: three failing fingerprints on one K2 are denied at the third attempt on real Redis
R1b: a successful third member is enforced only because fresh failing evidence exists in the same scope
R1c: four SUCCESSFUL fingerprints on one K2 are never denied on real Redis (no evidence)
R2: every key created has a TTL (no immortal state) on real Redis
R2 negative control: the rotation probes reached storage (no denial) and created keys
R2: largest set on real Redis stays within the largest declared cap (50)
R3 negative control: all 96 concurrent workers completed
R3: concurrent distinct failing members never push a set above the largest declared cap (50)
R3: in every round the concurrent failing members reached the threshold and a K2 block exists (no lost evidence)
R4 negative control: all 96 concurrent workers completed
R4: 8 concurrent failures of ONE fingerprint never create a block (duplicates never inflate evidence)
R5: the evidence marker counts exactly the 8 concurrent writers in every round (atomic increment, no lost update)
R6: the 60 s block is enforced right after the trigger on the Redis clock
R6: a lone legitimate client is allowed 63 s after the trigger (block and evidence both expired; no history-only re-block)
R6: a FRESH failing fingerprint after the expiry is fresh evidence and re-blocks the K2 on the Redis clock
